dish.note: Buttery jam drop biscuits, one for every bounce of Hilts' baseball off the cooler wall.
dish.how: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg and vanilla and mix in the flour. Roll into 24 balls, set them on lined trays, press a dip in each and fill with jam. Bake at 180C for 12 to 15 minutes until golden, then cool on the trays.
dish.make_ahead: Bake up to 3 days ahead and keep in an airtight tin

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg and vanilla and mix in the flour.
Roll into 24 balls on lined trays, press a dip in each and fill with jam.
Bake at 180C for 12 to 15 minutes until golden, then cool on the trays.
